verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿਤ ਅਉ ਸੋਮ ਭੌਮ ਬੁਧ ਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਸਪਤਿ ਸੁਕਰ ਸਨੀਚਰ ਸਾਤੋ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਂਟ ਲੀਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aadhit aau som bhauam budh hoo(n) brahasapat sukar saneechar saato baar baa(n)T leene hai ||

en.bdb: Starting from Sunday, all seven days of the week are overtaken by the gods like, Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn respectively.

verses.gurmukhi: ਥਿਤਿ ਪਛ ਮਾਸ ਰੁਤਿ ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਏਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਦਿਨ ਦੀਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: thit pachh maas rut logan mai logaachaar ek eka(n)kaar ko na kouoo dhin dheene hai ||

en.bdb: For fulfillment of all rites and rituals related to god-land, the society has further divided the time into bright and dark period. (waxing and wanning of moon) twelve months and six seasons. But not a day has been set aside for the remembrance and in the memory of One Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਅਸਟਮੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਉਮੀ ਏਕਾਦਸੀ ਭਈ ਦੁਆਦਸੀ ਚਤੁਰਦਸੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਏ ਕੀਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: janam asaTamee raam naumee ekaadhasee bhiee dhuaadhasee chaturadhasee janam e keene hai ||

en.bdb: God is free of births but Janam Ashtami, Ram Naumi and Ekadashi are the birth days of Lord Krishna, Lord Rama, and god Haribasar. Duadasi is the day of Vaman god, while Chaudasi is the day of Narsinh. These days have been fixed as birthdays of these gods.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਜਾ ਉਪਾਰਜਨ ਕੋ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਦਿਨ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਹੌ ਕੈਸੇ ਚੀਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੪੮੪॥
verses.translit_en: parajaa upaarajan ko na kouoo paavai dhin ajonee janam dhin kahau kaise cheene hai ||484||

en.bdb: No one can tell the day of the creation of this cosmos. Then how can one know the birthday of such Lord who is Ajuni (beyond birth) ? Thus worship of gods who are born and who die is futile. Worship of eternal Lord is only purposeful.  (484)
